HomePage.heading: Nicolas Van Labeke
HomePage.narrative_research_body: Twenty years of academic R&D at the intersection of artificial intelligence and education. From 3D geometry environments to NLP-driven essay analysis, the work centred on building systems that reason about learning.
HomePage.narrative_engineering_body: From research to production engineering. Building data-intensive frontend applications with React and TypeScript — currently at HiveMQ, developing the open-source frontend for HiveMQ Edge.
HomePage.featured_engineering_body: Open-source IIoT edge platform. Led the frontend from inception — React, TypeScript, Chakra UI, React Flow, and a bespoke design system.
HomePage.featured_publication_body: Full academic publication list sourced from Zotero — coming in Phase C.
HomePage.currently_body: Building the frontend for HiveMQ Edge — an open-source IIoT edge data platform connecting industrial devices to the cloud.
